ai.description: In 1948, Alan Turing penned a seminal paper that introduced the concept of intelligent machinery, paving the way for artificial intelligence as we know it. ai.title: LinkedIn CEO Daniel Shapero says AI-Savvy Gen Z has the Edge in Frozen Job Market | Vantage
ai.description:
LinkedIn CEO Daniel Shapero says that while the entry level job market is in a bad state at present, Gen Z is actually benefiting because companies are looking to hire young people who they believe are well versed with artificial intelligence. Shapero says that as firms look to embrace AI, they are turning to Gen Z because they think the youth are better suited to work with AI than older generations.
Firstpost looks at the job market dilemma, and the tensions between AI eliminating entry-level jobs but hiring being on the rise for AI-related work. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
